image_description: A pink minibus parked on a paved street, featuring 'My Pink Bus .com' branding. The side sliding door is open, revealing two women in formal pink dresses standing at the entrance. One woman holds a bouquet of flowers. The vehicle has a boxy shape, large windows, and standard van wheels.

The door is visibly retracted into the body panel, consistent with a sliding door design common in minibuses.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout typical of this class of vehicle.
